title: Step 9 architecture confirmation at two higher learning rates (MASTER_CONTEXT §37 step 9; founder approved 2026-09-28 "I approve EXP-033")
purpose: EXP-032 was LR-CONFOUNDED: lr 6e-3 improved the seed-1337 baseline by 0.0571 bpb, more than the baseline's seed spread, so its verdicts (all measured at lr 3e-3) may reflect the learning rate rather than the architecture. EXP-033 re-tests the EXP-032 candidates as a combined architecture at TWO higher learning rates and adopts a change only if it wins at BOTH, so the evaluation suite never selects a learning rate. The outcome is D-043, a PROVISIONAL architecture for GPU bring-up (step 10). Toy scale (transformer body ~1M of ~5.2M parameters): screening evidence only; it must be re-validated in the GPU scaling experiments (step 11).
pre_registered: 2026-09-28, before any EXP-033 result existed. Changing any field below after results exist requires a new experiment id.
checkpoint_note: The FINAL checkpoint is graded (fixed step budget), as in EXP-032; the trainer's 'best' checkpoint is chosen with the evaluation suite.
lrs_note: 6e-3 was the best learning rate in the EXP-032 check (seed 1337 only); 1e-2 tests whether the optimum lies higher. Nothing is chosen between them: every rule below must hold at both.

arms.name: baseline
arms.description: the EXP-B model unchanged: learned positions, SwiGLU (ffn_mult 4), RMSNorm, 4 query / 4 key-value heads, tied embeddings

arms.name: rope-gqa2
arms.description: the candidate: rotary positions (EXP-032 BETTER) + grouped-query attention with 2 key-value heads (EXP-032 ACCEPTABLE; halves the inference KV cache). SwiGLU and RMSNorm kept (LayerNorm showed no detectable difference in EXP-032).

arms.name: rope-gqa2-gelu
arms.description: the candidate with a GELU feed-forward (ffn_mult 6.0 keeps the feed-forward parameter count equal to SwiGLU's). EXP-032 found GELU better, which contradicts the literature (Narang et al. 2021; Shazeer 2020), so it is re-tested here.

comparisons.name: candidate-vs-baseline
comparisons.question: Is RoPE + GQA-2 better than the current baseline at both learning rates?

comparisons.name: gelu-vs-swiglu
comparisons.question: Inside the candidate architecture, is GELU (ffn_mult 6) better than SwiGLU (ffn_mult 4) at both learning rates?

reuse.note: EXP-032's lr-check cell is exactly this cell (same config, data, steps, seed, lr 6e-3). Reused only if its last/ checkpoint exists and its saved config matches; otherwise it is trained fresh. It is re-graded under EXP-033.

decision_rules.per_learning_rate: At each learning rate, delta = b - a in bits-per-byte from eval_compare (paired document bootstrap, 95%). BETTER if the CI upper bound < 0 AND every b seed beats every a seed. WORSE if the CI lower bound > 0 AND every a seed beats every b seed. Otherwise NO DETECTABLE DIFFERENCE AT THIS SCALE (the EXP-032 superiority rule).
decision_rules.divergence: A cell whose training stops on a non-finite loss is DIVERGED: it is recorded as a result (never retrained, not a failure) and counts as the worst possible score. If only one arm of a comparison has diverged seeds at a learning rate, that arm loses there (WORSE for b, BETTER for b if only a diverged). If both arms have diverged seeds, that learning rate is UNSTABLE and gives no verdict.
decision_rules.adoption: ADOPT only if the verdict is BETTER at every learning rate that is not UNSTABLE, and at least one learning rate is stable (fewer than all stable = weaker evidence, stated in D-043). Otherwise NOT ADOPTED.
decision_rules.d043: candidate-vs-baseline ADOPT -> the provisional architecture uses RoPE + GQA-2; NOT ADOPTED -> it keeps the baseline (learned positions, 4 KV heads), and GQA may be reconsidered later purely as an inference-efficiency choice. gelu-vs-swiglu ADOPT -> GELU (ffn_mult 6); NOT ADOPTED -> SwiGLU stays (literature prior). RMSNorm stays (EXP-032). The learning-rate trend is descriptive only; the step-10 GPU runs must sweep the learning rate again at their own scale.

eval_args_note: Contamination depends only on the suite and training data, which are identical to EXP-031/EXP-032 (0 exact / 0 13-gram overlaps); it is not re-computed per model.
